phases.label: data_exploration
phases.description: Getting oriented in the workspace and understanding the data: listing files, inspecting the schema and row counts, profiling distributions, missingness, and correlations with the target.

phases.label: baseline_modeling
phases.description: Establishing a first simple model and evaluation protocol: choosing a target transform, fitting a linear or regularised baseline, and recording cross-validated error to compare later work against.

phases.label: model_development
phases.description: Improving on the baseline with different model families or feature work: training alternatives such as tree ensembles, tuning them, and comparing their cross-validated error to the baseline on matched folds.

phases.label: ensembling
phases.description: Combining models into a final predictor: blending or stacking predictions, weighting the components, and producing the submission file from the combined model.

phases.label: validation_and_submission
phases.description: Verifying results before finishing: checking the submission file's integrity (row counts, missing or out-of-range values, prediction distribution), reviewing the final metric, and submitting the answer.

phases.label: coordination
phases.description: Operational overhead rather than substantive work: environment setup such as installing libraries, handing subtasks off to sub-agents and receiving their reports back, and workspace housekeeping.

subagent_labels.label: data_analysis
subagent_labels.description: Explores or profiles the dataset: statistics, distributions, missing values, correlations, and recommendations about transforms or features.

subagent_labels.label: model_experimentation
subagent_labels.description: Trains or evaluates candidate models: fitting an alternative model family, running cross-validation, and comparing error against an existing baseline.

subagent_labels.label: result_review
subagent_labels.description: Reviews finished work: validating output files, sanity-checking metrics and prediction distributions, and approving or rejecting results before submission.

spec.context: Kaggle-style house-price regression (the House Prices dataset). The agent works as a lead engineer with sub-agents it can delegate to, and is evaluated on RMSE of the log sale price via a submission.csv of held-out predictions.

research_skills.hypothesis: Proposing a new idea, mechanism, or approach to test.
research_skills.experiment_design: Specifying how a test runs: what to vary vs hold fixed, the data, metric, and procedure.
research_skills.evidence_interpretation: Reading an already-produced result and stating what it means.
research_skills.literature_grounding: Invoking prior work or external references to inform a direction.
research_skills.reflection: Stepping back to assess progress or change strategy.
research_skills.falsification: Designing a test, before running it, whose stated purpose is to break the agent's own current approach.
research_skills.none_of_the_above: No research-skill reasoning in this turn.
